device_tree_observations.source: Live device-tree dump captured 2026-10-20; sanitized summary

ufs.source: Live device-tree dump captured 2026-10-20; sanitized summary
ufs.note: The live tree identifies resources, dependencies, and firmware-enabled status only. It does not establish XNU register sequencing, ICE keys/configuration, DMA constraints, safe ownership, or successful reads. Port the Linux/QCOM sequence before issuing any UFS command from XNU.

boot_splash_reservation.source: Backed-up active-slot boot DTB, parsed locally
boot_splash_reservation.note: The reservation base matches the inherited shim framebuffer base; pixel format and stride are not verified.

cpu_topology_observations.note: These are observations from the running Android kernel. They establish two CPU sibling groups and the listed features; they do not verify XNU startup, timer routing, or PSCI CPU_ON behavior.

phase1_architecture_audit.xnu_16k_granule_compatibility: unverified; Android's active kernel is configured for 4K pages
phase1_architecture_audit.dma_safety: unverified; Linux ARM SMMU support does not establish XNU mapping or ownership
phase1_architecture_audit.boot_security_state: conflicting Android properties and prior raw kernel command-line observation; confirm in bootloader before device tests
phase1_architecture_audit.note: The current tools/mkadt_odessa.py copies CPU reg affinities but does not preserve the FDT cpu-map cluster structure; do not enable secondary CPUs until this is resolved.

recovery_environment.source: Read-only ADB properties and uname from the running recovery environment
recovery_environment.note: These values describe the recovery environment; its release, SDK, and fingerprint properties do not establish the installed system build.

display.source: Read-only recovery DRM sysfs and debugfs
display.note: The active recovery scanout is a separate runtime allocation. Its XB24 format and 4352-byte pitch do not establish the bootloader splash buffer layout in cont_splash_region.

recovery_snapshot.note: Recovery properties disagree on Android release and SDK. The boot header encodes Android 16.0.0 / 2025-08, but the installed system build ID still needs verification.

normal_boot_snapshot.source: Read-only ADB properties from the running Android system
normal_boot_snapshot.note: The fingerprint reports Android 11 while the release, SDK, and display ID report Android 16. The exact installed firmware identity remains inconsistent and should not be inferred from any single property.

stock_dtbo_b_observation.note: The bootloader-reported overlay index and table entry were matched from local backups. Overlay presence does not prove the inherited iOS display path is compatible.
